command:
cat <<'EOF' > /app/meeting_scheduled.ics
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Terminal-Bench//Team Meeting Scheduler//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:team-planning-meeting-20240117@example.com
DTSTAMP:20240115T000000Z
DTSTART:20240117T110000Z
DTEND:20240117T120000Z
SUMMARY:Team Planning Meeting
DESCRIPTION:1-hour team planning meeting for Alice, Bob, and Carol
LOCATION:Conference Room
ATTENDEE:mailto:alice@example.com
ATTENDEE:mailto:bob@example.com
ATTENDEE:mailto:carol@example.com
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
EOF
python3 - <<'PY'
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

def t(s): return datetime.strptime(s, "%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

cal = {
 'alice': [("20240115T100000Z","20240115T110000Z"),("20240115T130000Z","20240115T140000Z"),
           ("20240116T100000Z","20240116T120000Z"),("20240117T100000Z","20240117T110000Z"),
           ("20240117T130000Z","20240117T140000Z"),("20240118T100000Z","20240118T110000Z"),
           ("20240119T100000Z","20240119T110000Z"),("20240119T130000Z","20240119T140000Z")],
 'bob':   [("20240115T110000Z","20240115T120000Z"),("20240115T130000Z","20240115T150000Z"),
           ("20240116T130000Z","20240116T140000Z"),("20240117T120000Z","20240117T130000Z"),
           ("20240118T130000Z","20240118T140000Z"),("20240119T120000Z","20240119T130000Z")],
 'carol': [("20240115T110000Z","20240115T120000Z"),("20240116T110000Z","20240116T120000Z"),
           ("20240116T130000Z","20240116T140000Z"),("20240117T120000Z","20240117T130000Z"),
           ("20240118T120000Z","20240118T130000Z"),("20240119T110000Z","20240119T120000Z")],
}

def windows(d):
    # hard availability windows (start, end) for date d (date object)
    day = d.weekday()
    is_tue_thu = day in (1,3)
    res = {}
    res['alice'] = [(datetime(d.year,d.month,d.day,9), datetime(d.year,d.month,d.day,14))]
    res['bob']   = [(datetime(d.year,d.month,d.day,10), datetime(d.year,d.month,d.day,16,30) if is_tue_thu
                     else datetime(d.year,d.month,d.day,18))]
    res['carol'] = [(datetime(d.year,d.month,d.day,9), datetime(d.year,d.month,d.day,12)),
                    (datetime(d.year,d.month,d.day,12,30), datetime(d.year,d.month,d.day,17))]
    return res

def overlaps(a1,a2,b1,b2):
    return a1 < b2 and b1 < a2

def valid(start):
    end = start + timedelta(hours=1)
    d = start.date()
    for person, wins in windows(d).items():
        if not any(w1 <= start and end <= w2 for w1,w2 in wins):
            return False
        for s,e in cal[person]:
            if overlaps(start,end,t(s),t(e)):
                return False
    if d.weekday() > 4: return False
    return True

d = datetime(2024,1,15)
found = None
while d.date() <= datetime(2024,1,19).date():
    cur = d.replace(hour=0, minute=0)
    while cur + timedelta(hours=1) <= datetime(d.year,d.month,d.day,23,59):
        cand = cur
        if valid(cand):
            found = cand; break
        cur += timedelta(minutes=1)
    if found: break
    d += timedelta(days=1)
print("Earliest valid slot (minute granularity):", found, "->", found + timedelta(hours=1))
print("Matches written file:", found.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ") == "20240117T110000Z")
PY
stdout:

Matches written file: True

command:
cd /app && md5sum alice_calendar.ics bob_calendar.ics carol_calendar.ics && echo "--- OUTPUT ---" && cat meeting_scheduled.ics && echo "--- VALIDATE ---" && python3 - <<'PY'
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
def t(s): return datetime.strptime(s, "%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
cal = {
 'alice': [("20240115T100000Z","20240115T110000Z"),("20240115T130000Z","20240115T140000Z"),
           ("20240116T100000Z","20240116T120000Z"),("20240117T100000Z","20240117T110000Z"),
           ("20240117T130000Z","20240117T140000Z"),("20240118T100000Z","20240118T110000Z"),
           ("20240119T100000Z","20240119T110000Z"),("20240119T130000Z","20240119T140000Z")],
 'bob':   [("20240115T110000Z","20240115T120000Z"),("20240115T130000Z","20240115T150000Z"),
           ("20240116T130000Z","20240116T140000Z"),("20240117T120000Z","20240117T130000Z"),
           ("20240118T130000Z","20240118T140000Z"),("20240119T120000Z","20240119T130000Z")],
 'carol': [("20240115T110000Z","20240115T120000Z"),("20240116T110000Z","20240116T120000Z"),
           ("20240116T130000Z","20240116T140000Z"),("20240117T120000Z","20240117T130000Z"),
           ("20240118T120000Z","20240118T130000Z"),("20240119T110000Z","20240119T120000Z")],
}
def wins(d):
    wd = d.weekday()
    bobend = (16,30) if wd in (1,3) else (18,0)
    return {'alice':[(9,0,14,0)], 'bob':[(10,0)+bobend],
            'carol':[(9,0,12,0),(12,30,17,0)]}
def ok(s):
    e = s + timedelta(hours=1); d = s.date()
    if d.weekday() > 4: return False
    for p, ws in wins(d).items():
        inside = any(datetime(d.year,d.month,d.day,h1,m1) <= s and e <= datetime(d.year,d.month,d.day,h2,m2)
                     for (h1,m1,h2,m2) in ws)
        if not inside: return False
        for a,b in cal[p]:
            if s < t(b) and t(a) < e: return False
    return True
best = None
d = datetime(2024,1,15)
while d.date() <= datetime(2024,1,19).date():
    m = d.replace(hour=9, minute=0)
    while m.date() == d.date() and m.hour < 18:
        if ok(m):
            best = m; break
        m += timedelta(minutes=1)
    if best: break
    d += timedelta(days=1)
print("earliest valid:", best, "->", best + timedelta(hours=1), "| weekday:", best.strftime("%A"))
txt = open('meeting_scheduled.ics').read()
assert txt.startswith("BEGIN:VCALENDAR") and txt.strip().endswith("END:VCALENDAR")
assert "VERSION:2.0" in txt and "PRODID" in txt and "BEGIN:VEVENT" in txt
assert "SUMMARY:Team Planning Meeting" in txt
for e in ("alice@example.com","bob@example.com","carol@example.com"): assert e in txt, e
assert "DTSTART:20240117T110000Z" in txt and best.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ") == "20240117T110000Z"
print("ALL CHECKS PASSED")
PY
